fields.DESCRIPTION: Stay healthy and refreshed with this premium Dr. Jal Pure Copper Water Bottle. Traditionally endorsed by Ayurveda, drinking water stored in copper vessels is believed to balance the body’s doshas, improve digestion, boost immunity, and promote overall well-being. This sleek and durable design comes with a leak-proof cap and an easy-to-carry strap, making it perfect for home, office, or travel use.
